dct_description_sm: The City of Kelowna requires development permits addressing design guidelines as outlined in the 2040 Official Community Plan (OCP). Incorporating these Guidelines into a project’s design will encourage the creation of contextual and compatible architecture, high quality pedestrian realms, resilient and context-sensitive design, and will contribute to placemaking and design excellence in Kelowna.The OCP was adopted by Council on the 10th of January, 2022. Read more about the 2040 OCP on kelowna.ca.
